template.name: ClockTick
template.declaration:
/* ClockTick: • Global timer automaton with local clock c. • As long as game_over == false and global_clock < TIMEOUT: – waits until c ≥ 1, then does “c = 0, global_clock = global_clock + 1,” effectively incrementing global_clock once per time unit. • When game_over becomes true (tower destroyed or victory), moves to Stopped so that time can continue to elapse (letting other automata advance), but global_clock no longer increments. */
clock c;

template.name: GameMonitor
template.declaration: /* GameMonitor: • Watches three conditions to end the game: 1) Win: global_clock ≥ LAST_SPAWN AND all_enemies_gone() AND lives > 0 → WinState 2) Lose: lives ≤ 0 → LoseState 3) Timeout: global_clock ≥ TIMEOUT → Timeout • In any of those three committed terminal states, it then transitions to “Done” (urgent), which freezes further transitions but allows time to keep ticking elsewhere. • Setting game_over = true in each terminal ensures ClockTick will switch to Stopped. */
